package invalid

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
)

func invalidSource(objects project.Objects, backend db.Queryer) {
	_ = objects.BlogPost.SelectRelated(authors.AuthorObjects.Using(backend))
}
